steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.

attacks.name: Atom Splitter
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
|!hit| |*Pursuit|: After this attack is resolved, this character may Advance Toward the defender |!movement_small|.

attacks.name: Death Blow
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character may advance |!range_medium|.
|!wild| |!block| |*Flurry|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make a Strike attack.

superPowers.name: Glaive‘s Edge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: Place this character within |!range| 1 of its current position. Then this character may make a Strike or Death Blow attack. During that attack, this character adds blanks in its attack roll to its total successes.

superPowers.name: Husband of Proxima Midnight
superPowers.body: At the end of this character's activation, if it is within |!range| 3 of an allied Proxima Midnight, this character may use this superpower. If the allied Proxima Midnight does not have an activated token, she may activate before your turn ends.

superPowers.name: Glaive of Immortality
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.

erratas.body: Stamina increased from 6 to 7 on Healthy side.
Atom Splitter gains a new Pursuit special rule that triggers on |!hit|.
Glaive's Edge now takes an Action, and requires Corvus to Place within |!range| 1 of its current position before the attack.
Death Blow's Flurry now requires |!wild| and |!block| to trigger, instead of |!block|.
Husband of Proxima Midnight's Power Cost increased from 0 to 1.
Husband of Proxima Midnight requires Corvus Glaive to be within |!range| 3 of Proxima Midnight, instead of |!range| 4.
